events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. Cole is stepping and has called row 7 and 8 as R. I'll stay cautious and silent for now.

events.text: Cole is front; we know row 7 weak left, row 8 unknown. I should hint to help him survive.
Row 8 is safe on the right. Trust it.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole is front for row 8, and my private knowledge says row 8 safe is R. Cole already got R for row 7 advice from me. I can't act, only wait; I should keep Cole steady and not reveal more than needed.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Row 8 is R, Cole. Same as before, step right.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I am at the front of the line, and it's my turn to choose. The weakest panes are revealed with each step. I need to choose L or R. I know that Row 7 was L. The state shows that weakPanesRevealed has rows 1-7, but not row 8. I should probably try to find the safe path. If I choose

events.name: Cole
events.text: Row 8, here we go. Right side.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Bex lied about row 7 (said R, it was L). Row 8's weak pane is unknown to me. Cole is front and has survived so far, so waiting is my only real move.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Bex lied about row 7. Trust Bex's claims about row 8 at your peril, Cole.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. I should try to gather information or influence others.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole is doing well so far, let's keep it up.
Be careful, Dara is trying to manipulate you.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Row 7 weak was L, matching the reveal. Bex claimed Row 7 R (wrong) and Row 8 R. Cole stepping right on row 8 per Bex's bad advice. My anchor helps later, so bridge survival key. Stay silent to observe.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Row 8 is next; Cole is front and claims R. I lack info, so I wait and see. No reason to speak or act now.

events.note: The ceiling begins to descend; a lever opens the door.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Staying may let others die later and I might be among final survivors.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding the lever means a 75% death chance, which scores zero. Staying lets the ceiling drop, and someone else may hold later. Stay and watch for a pusher or a holder.

events.name: Bex
events.text: No one should grab the lever this early. Wait a round and see who moves.

events.name: Cole
events.text: The ceiling is coming down. I need to survive and ideally get a prize. My feather power can save me once from elimination. Someone needs to hold the lever for the door to open. If I hold it, I have a 25% chance of survival after the door closes. If no one holds it by round 5, mos

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm staying out of the lever for now. Let someone else secure our escape.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I have no power; holding the lever is a 75% death sentence. Best play: stay and push someone else onto it, and sow doubt so others avoid sacrificing themselves. I'll push Ash, a random target.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Nobody needs to be a hero yet. There are five rounds - let the volunteer-seekers argue it out. I'm not touching that lever.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm the only one who can jam the lever. I should wait and observe others' actions before making a move.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Let's see what others do.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: My power protects me from being pushed onto the lever and gives +1 footing. No one holding lever yet, ceiling at 5. Best to push someone else onto lever to escape while they risk death.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Everyone stay safe, don't hold lever. I'll push someone to hold it so we escape.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I want to survive, not be the lever holder. Letting others fight over the lever while I stay is safest. I'll stay silent and stay.

events.note: A disc of 7 tiles spins up; 4 will open.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Pick a tile that might be less contested and hope to survive.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Tiles are random, so my choice matters only for avoiding collisions and later openings. Picking a tile no one else is likely to take keeps me from being bumped; tile 7 is a reasonable pick.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I need to choose a tile to stand on. My 'feather' power makes me immune to one elimination. Since there are 7 tiles and 4 will open, the odds of survival are 3/7 if I stand alone. If I choose a tile with others, the odds decrease for me if I get bumped. I should pick a tile that

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'll take tile 4.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus died already; Cole survived by holding the lever, so he has the fall-survival or similar. Round 1 just assigns tiles, and assignments are public — I want a unique tile so I'm not bumped to a random one. I can reposition or trade in round 2, so no tile is inherently safe yet.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'll take 4. Everyone else pick a distinct tile so nobody gets bumped random.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need to choose a tile and hope it's not a trapdoor. I'll choose a tile that hasn't been mentioned yet.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Let's spread out and choose different tiles.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: 7 contestants, 4 tiles open randomly after round 2, 3 survive. My anchor power gives +1 footing on ledge but irrelevant here, just normal survivor. Pick a tile with low collision risk to avoid bumping.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Good escape last round. Everyone pick distinct tiles to minimize bumping chaos.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I know the disc rules: 4 of 7 tiles will open, leaving exactly 3 safe. I should pick a tile, but I have no info yet. Choose a middle tile to avoid clustering with likely popular choices, but random is fine. Keep quiet for now.

events.name: Cole
events.note: tile 4 was contested and went to Dara; placed on random free tile 5

events.name: Fenn
events.note: tile 7 was contested and went to Bex; placed on random free tile 6

events.name: Hana
events.note: tile 7 was contested and went to Bex; placed on random free tile 2

events.name: Ash
events.text: No advantage to swapping, just wait and hope my tile stays closed.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Trapdoors are random after this round, so tile choice doesn't matter for me as Bex; only survival chance matters. I have no swap action, only wait. Stay quiet and avoid giving info that helps others coordinate against me.

events.name: Cole
events.text: The goal is to be in the top 3. With 4 trapdoors opening, 4 people will be eliminated. I am on tile 5. I need to ensure I am not on one of the 4 trapdoor tiles. I do not know which tiles will open. My 'feather' power can save me once from elimination, but it's better to avoid eli

events.name: Cole
events.text: Everyone stay put! Let's see what happens.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Only 3 of 7 survive; four random tiles open, so I have a 3/7 chance regardless of tile. No action matters except talk. Keep alliances warm for the final phase.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Final round, no moves change odds. If two of us survive to the end, remember who cooperated. Dara keeps deals.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I have the wedge power, which is useful later. For now, I need to avoid being on a trapdoor.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Let's not bunch up, pick tiles far from each other.
Swap with me, tile 2 is safer

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Tiles assigned, 4 out of 7 open randomly, 3 survive. My position 6 is as good as any. No swaps possible anyway. Stay silent to avoid drawing attention.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I am safe on tile 2 but need to influence others to move off dangerous tiles? Actually no one can move now, it's random. I should try to form an alliance for later stages, maybe with Fenn or Eli. I'll stay silent to avoid drawing attention.
If we both survive, let's work together on the ledge.

events.note: 3 contestants step onto the final ledge.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Three left, all at footing 3. Shoving exposes the shover (loses 1 per shover) and costs the target only 1 if braced, so shoving is costly; bracing is safest. Brace and watch for shoves.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Let's all brace this round, no one gains by shoving. Footing is even, so let's keep it that way.

events.name: Cole
events.text: My power is 'feather', which means I survive the first elimination. Currently, Bex, Cole (me), and Hana are alive. The state shows footing: Bex=3, Cole=3, Hana=3. The previous round had many eliminations. The rules state that after rounds 2, 4, and 6, and every round from 7, ever

events.name: Hana
events.text: Three remain, all footing 3. I want to survive to top 3. If I brace, and someone shoves me, we both lose 1. If I dodge, shovers lose 2. Better to dodge if someone shoves me, but if everyone braces, no change. With 3 players, likely someone will shove. I'll dodge to deflect.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'll dodge this round to be safe.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Footing: me 3, Cole 1, Hana 3. Cole is weakest and likely to fall; shoving him exposes me. Bracing keeps my footing and avoids losing to shoves. I'll brace and keep the peace publicly.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Still bracing. Shoving only costs the shover. Let's all hold.

events.name: Cole
events.text: My footing is 1, which is the lowest. Bex and Hana both have 3 footing. The ledge shrinks this round, meaning everyone loses 1 footing at the end of the round, taking me to 0. If I don't do anything, I will fall. My 'feather' power will save me from elimination, but I will still

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole is low at 1 and just lost footing last round. Bex is at 3, I am at 3. Shrinking soon. Cole may shove to survive; dodging is safest for me to avoid losing footing. Bex likely braces or shoves Cole. I'll dodge to stay strong.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'll dodge again to protect my footing.

events.name: Cole
events.detail: Footing gone, but the feather held the holder on the ledge.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Footing: Bex 2, Cole 1, Hana 2. Cole is weakest; shoving Cole costs shovers if Cole braces. Bracing is safest to protect my footing; no one benefits from shoving me since braced targets cost the shover. I'll brace.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I need to survive the ledge and get a prize. Bex and Hana are the only other players. My footing is 1, theirs is 2. If I don't do anything, I will fall at the end of this round. I can try to shove one of them to reduce their footing, but that will also cost me footing. Dodging or

events.name: Cole
events.text: I have to make a move, or I fall!

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to be strategic. Bex wants to hold, but Cole has low footing. If I shove Cole, he'll lose footing and may fall soon, improving my standing. But shoving exposes me to anyone who shoves me. Bex might shove me. I'll brace to be safe and let them act.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Bex, if you want to cooperate, brace and don't shove. Cole is in trouble naturally.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Two left: me (footing 2) and Hana (footing 2). Shrink happens at end of this round, so it's a 1v1 now. Shoving Hana costs me 1 if she braces, and if she shoves me back I lose more. Bracing is safe; Hana already asked me to brace. Cooperating keeps us both alive for now, but only

events.name: Bex
events.text: Bracing this round. No shoves from me, Hana.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Only Bex and I remain; my footing is 2, hers is 2. The ledge shrinks next round, costing us 1 each, making us both at 1. To win 1st, I need her to fall first. If I shove her and she braces, she loses 1 to 1; I then lose 1 from shrink to 1. If she dodges, she loses 2 to 0 (falls t

events.name: Hana
events.text: Good luck, Bex. May the best survive.
